profile_definitions.title: Standard commute
profile_definitions.description: Original fixed synthetic commute experiment, including route22 service gap and downtown BART delay.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim

profile_definitions.title: Route 38 driver shortage
profile_definitions.description: Half of scheduled route38 departures are unavailable from minute30 to150. Fixed standby vehicle/driver pools remain available to every harness.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim

timeline.label: Synthetic route38 driver shortage · alternate scheduled trips canceled

profile_definitions.title: Downtown BART interruption
profile_definitions.description: Departures from Embarcadero, Montgomery and Powell take eight additional minutes from minute30 to120; valid GTFS connections remain unchanged.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim

profile_definitions.title: Fictional stadium exit
profile_definitions.description: Mission Bay-origin residential OD batches from minute90 through120 contain three times their otherwise seeded rider counts. Represents a fictional crowd egress, not an actual event.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim

timeline.label: Fictional Mission Bay stadium exit · seeded OD counts ×3

profile_definitions.title: Low voluntary guidance uptake
profile_definitions.description: Same seeded demand and disruptions as standard; voluntary alternative-route acceptance probability is fixed at10%.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim

profile_definitions.title: Balanced low-demand control
profile_definitions.description: Half-scale synthetic demand and no driver/BART disruptions. Physical standby resources and evaluator are unchanged.
profile_definitions.provenance: Fully synthetic experiment profile on observed GTFS connectivity; no actual incident, live availability, crowd count or historical ridership claim
